craft_notes: Sthāyin: heart-start. Rows: though-yet-hence. Read aloud: weighed decree.

lines: Though in the frame, warp-and-woof without-within, is breath —
yet plain-felt striving starts at the heart —
hence from there alone declare it.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra yady api dehe sabāhyābhyantaram otaprotarūpaḥ prāṇaḥ tathāpi prasphuṭasaṃvedyaprayatnaḥ asau hṛdayāt prabhṛti iti tata eva ayaṃ nirūpaṇīyaḥ
